verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a command-line media transcoding tool and library. It has no hosted or stored automation objects, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Users may keep scripts or filtergraph files in external version control, but that is a user-side workaround, not a product capability, and nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg shipping such a feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
